recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-7597 unless the Security WG opens a new tracker to revisit Provenance activity semantics more broadly.
issue_request: FHIR-7597 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 FHIR-core Provenance request asking whether the resource lacked a way to record the action performed on the entity/target, or whether a default create action was implied. The recorded resolution says the issue was resolved by adding Provenance.activity.
initial_application: No exact FHIR-7597 issue-keyed commit was found. Git commit 6c026c5064671ebbd76e4679a2e250ea2074e89d, 'staging for Provenance improvements ballot comment resolution,' added a Provenance.activity row to the old source/provenance/provenance-spreadsheet.xml with CodeableConcept type, ProvenanceActivity binding, and short text 'Activity that occurred.' Later source migrations carried that element into source/provenance/structuredefinition-Provenance.xml.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists provenance=Provenance, making the current Provenance StructureDefinition build input. The current source defines Provenance.activity as 0..1 CodeableConcept with a binding to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/provenance-activity-type. Later related reconciliations for FHIR-13013, FHIR-53917, and FHIR-55410 are already present on the combined branch and refine the value set, removal/replace behavior, and activity wording without reversing the action-capturing element.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current specification already satisfies the FHIR-7597 resolution, and adding redundant prose about create/update/delete actions would not change implementer understanding.
